verdict.rationale: cubic's own docs say it automatically reviews every new pull request. Flex capacity keeps reviews running past included capacity, and auto-approval lets low-risk PRs skip human review, so automated review can handle high PR volume. The AI coding analytics tab also tracks how much merged code AI tools wrote. However, nothing documents special verification or gating for agent-authored PRs, and nothing shows performance at volumes beyond human capacity. missing for 10: explicit handling or gating of agent-authored PRs, independent or hands-on evidence of review quality at high AI-PR volume, documented throughput or scale limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the reviewer holds the line on AI-generated PRs — it verifies agent-authored code at a volume no human team could review

citations.quote: Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
The AI automatically scans every pull request for a wide range of issues, including logic errors, style inconsistencies, and potential security vulnerabilities.
Flex capacity keeps GitHub PR AI reviews running after your workspace uses its included reviewed-line capacity.
Auto-approval lets you skip human review for pull requests that cubic determines are low risk and issue-free.
The AI coding tab (Beta) shows how much of your merged code was written with AI tools, which tools and models wrote it
